# Traefik — root-context-push-url

root-context with VAADIN_PUSH_URL=/VAADIN/push. The config is identical to root-context: Traefik upgrades on every route, so a relocated PUSH endpoint needs no rule of its own, where the Apache and NGINX siblings each add a block for it.

Proxy URL on `http://localhost:9090`: `/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

Traefik dynamic config (`vaadin.yml`), mounted into
`/etc/traefik/dynamic`:

```yaml
# root-context with VAADIN_PUSH_URL=/VAADIN/push.
#
# This file is identical to root-context/vaadin.yml, and that is the finding.
# The Apache and NGINX siblings both need an extra block for the relocated
# endpoint — a ws:// ProxyPass, or a dedicated location with the Upgrade
# headers — because the endpoint had to be taught to upgrade. Traefik upgrades
# on every route already, so a relocated push URL is just another path the
# catch-all router carries.
http:
  routers:
    vaadin:
      rule: PathPrefix(`/`)
      entryPoints:
        - web
      middlewares:
        - compress
      service: vaadin

  services:
    vaadin:
      loadBalancer:
        servers:
          - url: http://vaadin:8080

  middlewares:
    compress:
      compress:
        excludedContentTypes:
          - text/event-stream
          - text/plain
```

The entryPoints and the file provider come from the shared
[traefik.yml](../../traefik.yml), mounted read-only.
